personalSettingsBlock.title: Personal Settings
personalSettingsBlock.description: A complete personal settings workspace for managing model services, API keys, credentials, profile details, and usage.
personalSettingsBlock.interactionBody: The sidebar changes the current settings page. Each inventory view supports search, while model lists can expand to show every available model.
personalSettingsBlock.guidanceBody: Use this block as the authenticated account surface where one person manages their model access and personal configuration.
personalSettingsBlock.dataBoundaryBody: The block uses mock records and local state only. Replace the supplied data and connect mutations, search, and pagination to your product services.
